observedFacts.fact: The ADM Map is available at /map and has the page title 'Map | Rx2Go'.
Hawaii was the visibly selected facility and service-area or hub context.
observedFacts.evidence: Both context comboboxes displayed Hawaii as selected.

observedFacts.fact: The Map automatically filtered Order Hubs to Hawaii during the observed session.
The page supports Drivers, Regions, and Orders sections.
observedFacts.evidence: Three visible tab controls in the settings panel.

observedFacts.fact: The Regions section associates visible regions with map polygons and order counts.
observedFacts.evidence: Expanded Regions panel, map overlays, and drawRegions response.

observedFacts.fact: The observed Map state used delivery mode, a displayed delivery date, Ready for Delivery status, a hub filter, and current map bounds when loading markers.
observedFacts.evidence: markersTest request body and visible UI.

observedFacts.fact: Auto-refresh and Queue mode were checked on initial observation.
The page exposes AI route-planning and route-generation affordances.

baselineComparison.currentFact: This exploration establishes the currently verified ADM Map baseline.
baselineComparison.evidence: The requested knowledge layer is ADM_BASELINE and no comparison baseline was supplied.

changesFromPrevious.fact: A live ADM baseline observation was captured for the Map module.
changesFromPrevious.evidence: The authenticated /map route, controls, relationships, and supporting network calls were observed directly.

uncertainties: The effects of changing facility, hub, client, date, queue mode, or auto-refresh were not tested to avoid disturbing the existing context.
Drivers and Orders panel contents could not be fully inspected because attempted clicks did not complete reliably while the Map was refreshing.
Mutation-capable controls such as Delete All, route optimization, polygon drawing, polygon editing, region deletion, and route-name assignment were deliberately not activated.
Icon-only per-region actions could not be assigned exact purposes from accessible names alone.
No separate child-page route was proven for Regions Logs, Layers, or the route-generation panel.
AI route-planner response schemas were not inspected deeply enough to identify stable important fields.
result.summary: ADM /map is a delivery operations map scoped by facility, hub, date, client, status, and geographic bounds. In the verified Hawaii context it displayed delivery markers, region polygons, region order counts, Drivers/Regions/Orders sections, queue and optimization controls, map-layer tools, and AI route-planning affordances. No business data was mutated.
